Khiyal Chadar-e-Zainab Ka Aaya Ghazi Ko
Hazaron Taigon Se Naizon Se Mara Logon Ne
Kuch Aisay Kata Hai Maqtal Mein Lasha Logon Ne
Jagah Jagah Se Hai Sheh Ne Uthaya Ghazi Ko
Pukara Ghora Yeh Sheh Ko Jisay Sanbhala Hai
Ghira Hai Taigon Mein Aao Woh Girney Wala Hai
Larazta Pusht Pe Oss Ne Jo Paya Ghazi Ko
Alam Gira Tu Ridaein Bhi Gir Gayin Sar Se
Sadaein Bibiyaan Deti Thi Khaimon Ke Dar Se
Keh Raas Pani Bhi Lana Na Aaya Ghazi Ko
Gala Katay Tu Katay Mashk Ko Bachana Hai
Sakina Pyasi Hai Pani Ossay Pilana Hai
Hai Azn Baba Se Oss Ne Dilaya Ghazi Ko
Laga Jo Teer Sakina Ki Mashk Mein Aa Kar
Tarap Tarap Ke Woh Takra Raha Tha Zeen Se Sar
Sitam Ke Teer Ne Itna Rulaya Ghazi Ko
Jab Oss Ka Aakhri Sansoon Mein Pochta Tha Jarri
Tu Sar Katay Hoye Shano Se Peetta Tha Jarri
Jo Sheh Ne Hal-e-Sakina Sunaya Ghazi Ko
Khula Yeh Ghazi Pe Naizon Ke Zakhm Khilaney Se
Laeen Marein Gay Zainab Ko Taziyane Se
Sitam Woh Kaisay Karein Gay Dikhaya Ghazi Ko
ASAD Yeh Sheh Ko Tha Sadma Guzar Gaye Ghazi
Kaha Hussain Ko Bhai Tu Mar Gaye Ghazi
Galay Se Sheh Ne Jo Ro Kar Lagaya Ghazi Ko
